name: petlink
description: A five-user, room-based connected desktop pet MVP.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @petlink/protocol && npm run build -w @petlink/server && npm run build -w @petlink/desktop
scripts.check: npm run check -w @petlink/protocol && npm run check -w @petlink/server && npm run check -w @petlink/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @petlink/protocol && npm run test -w @petlink/server && npm run test -w @petlink/desktop
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @petlink/protocol && npm run dev -w @petlink/server
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build -w @petlink/protocol && npm run tauri:dev -w @petlink/desktop
